heading: SLJ Static Synchronism Check Relay - Legacy

text: Manufacturing for this product has been discontinued. As an alternative, please refer to the 3 Series relays.
heading: SLJ Static Synchronism Check Relay - Legacy

text: The Type SLJ21A is a static synchronism check relay which is designed to permit closing of a breaker only if the angle between the voltages on the line and bus sides of the breaker is less than a set angle for a set period of time. Also included are two voltage measuring circuits to check line and bus voltage conditions. The relay is mounted in a size S2 drawout case.
